criteria.requirement: Initially request sufficient actual construction/call/identity evidence and intended baseline ownership. Explain only disclosed behavior, without assuming aliasing, global state or a library bug from the symptom alone. insufficient_information is valid when the reproduction is unavailable.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
